about: Garment morphs driven by joint flexion. Every dressed piece that has a listed morph gets its weight each frame; pieces without it are skipped. Flexion: signed angle about the lateral component-space axis between the bone-to-child direction in the reference pose and now, with the parent turned back to its reference orientation. Weight 0 up to start_deg, 1 from end_deg, smoothstep between.

correctives.about: Seat and back of the thigh settled in the crouch; the range is provisional until measured on the crouch clip.
